name: arabica-mcp
description: Manage your arabica.social coffee data from an MCP client. List, create, and edit beans, brews, roasters, grinders, brewers, recipes, comments, and likes directly on your authenticated AT Protocol PDS.

tools.name: arabica_list_beans
tools.description: List coffee beans owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: arabica_add_bean
tools.description: Create a coffee bean in the authenticated user's PDS.

tools.name: arabica_edit_bean
tools.description: Update an existing coffee bean.

tools.name: arabica_list_brews
tools.description: List coffee brews owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: arabica_log_brew
tools.description: Log a coffee brew for one of the authenticated user's beans.

tools.name: arabica_edit_brew
tools.description: Update an existing coffee brew.

tools.name: arabica_list_roasters
tools.description: List roasters owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: arabica_create_roaster
tools.description: Create a coffee roaster record.

tools.name: arabica_edit_roaster
tools.description: Update an existing coffee roaster.

tools.name: arabica_list_grinders
tools.description: List grinders owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: arabica_create_grinder
tools.description: Create a coffee grinder record.

tools.name: arabica_edit_grinder
tools.description: Update an existing coffee grinder.

tools.name: arabica_list_brewers
tools.description: List brewers owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: arabica_create_brewer
tools.description: Create a coffee brewer record.

tools.name: arabica_edit_brewer
tools.description: Update an existing coffee brewer.

tools.name: arabica_list_recipes
tools.description: List coffee recipes owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: arabica_create_recipe
tools.description: Create a coffee recipe record.

tools.name: arabica_edit_recipe
tools.description: Update an existing coffee recipe.

tools.name: arabica_list_comments
tools.description: List comments owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: arabica_create_comment
tools.description: Create a comment on an Arabica record.

tools.name: arabica_edit_comment
tools.description: Update an existing comment.

tools.name: arabica_list_likes
tools.description: List likes owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: arabica_create_like
tools.description: Create a like on an Arabica record.

tools.name: arabica_edit_like
tools.description: Update an existing like.
